description: This file defines a suggestionService module that provides functions to generate product suggestions based on user order history, including scoring logic, context text generation, and cart addition helper.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Fetches user order data, scores products based on frequency and recency, sorts, and returns a list of suggested products with context.

methods.name: scoreFromOrders
methods.description: Creates a scoring map for products based on order data, considering frequency, recency, and category diversity.

methods.name: contextText
methods.description: Generates friendly text describing how recently a product was purchased.

methods.name: addOneToCart
methods.description: Adds a specified product to the cart via API call.
